verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Bindings for connecting to external databases/APIs (docs-10) and generic Zero Trust/WAF network security (docs-18), but nothing documents a specific mechanism (e.g., private Worker-to-Worker service bindings or a documented private-network route) for keeping internal service-to-service calls off the public internet without VPC setup. No first-party or community evidence directly addresses this specific networking pattern.
